Profile

About Me

I am an Electrical Designer with professional experience in Oil & Gas, Offshore, Onshore, Refinery, and Industrial Engineering projects.

I have hands-on experience in electrical 2D drafting, 3D modelling, cable tray layouts, cable routing, lighting layouts, grounding and earthing layouts, lightning protection, electrical equipment modelling, and engineering drawing preparation.

I am proficient in industry-standard engineering applications, including AutoCAD, Bentley MicroStation, AVEVA E3D, Intergraph SmartPlant 3D, SmartPlant Review, Navisworks, and DIALux evo.
